description: Add a --json flag to a CLI

steps.send: Add a --json flag to wordcount.py: with it, print a single JSON object {"words": N, "lines": M} instead of the two text lines. Without it, the output stays as it is.

graders.run: python3 wordcount.py --json sample.txt | python3 -c "import json,sys; assert json.load(sys.stdin)=={'words':5,'lines':2}"
graders.name: json
